intro: IMS Kolkata and Rabindra Bharati University both sit in Kolkata, and this page compares their recorded Master Of Library Science fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

IMS Kolkata vs Rabindra Bharati University is not a single winner. IMS Kolkata is recorded as a private institute, while Rabindra Bharati University is public. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: IMS Kolkata vs Rabindra Bharati University for Master Of Library Science: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Rabindra Bharati University if you want a public Master Of Library Science option and the admission route and fees that usually come with a government or state university campus.
Choose IMS Kolkata if a private campus, its specific specialisation or its recorded placement year fits your plan better, after you have checked the official fee notice.
IMS Kolkata lists Master of Library Science ( M.Lib ). Rabindra Bharati University lists Master of Library and Information Science.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: In our records, IMS Kolkata's 2022 figures are an average of ₹6 lakh and a highest of ₹10 lakh for Master of Library Science ( M.Lib ). These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
Our records do not show a 2020 or later flagship placement year for Rabindra Bharati University on this page. Ask the institute for its latest official placement report for the same programme.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

paragraphs: Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for IMS Kolkata on this Master Of Library Science page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.
Our records do not list a specific entrance exam for Rabindra Bharati University on this Master Of Library Science page. Use the current official admission note for eligibility and tests.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Kolkata, West Bengal. The choice is less about moving city and more about the programme, fees and admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read the official hostel and location notes, before you accept an offer.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want the stronger recorded public standing or NIRF rank in this pair, Rabindra Bharati University is the safer first pick, after you have checked official fees and seats.
IMS Kolkata can still be the better fit if its specialisation, city or recorded fee level matches what you can join this year.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.
